bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches and small clutches up to 6 × 9 inches are permitted. Every bag is subject to search.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General grass-lot parking is included with a ticket; Reserved and VIP upgrades are in Lot A, and larger vehicles use Lot B. Lots generally open one hour before gates, and upgrade pass sales end 14 days before a show.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Tell parking attendants that you are using rideshare; they will direct the car. For pickups, arrive by 9 p.m. to access the Lot B pickup area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are sold at plazas throughout the grounds. Fans can also bring food in one clear one-gallon resealable bag per person.
allowed: Food in one clear one-gallon bag
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking in the paved lots is complimentary and first come, first served with a placard. Contact the venue at least two weeks before the concert to request an interpreter.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Guests who leave cannot return without a new ticket.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will-call tickets are picked up at the box office with a photo ID matching the purchaser’s name. The show-day box office opens when parking opens and closes when the headliner begins.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The main entrance accepts all fans; premium seat holders can use the private Lot A entrance. Parking and gate times vary by show and are posted about one week beforehand; security uses detectors or pat-downs.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
